[[File:1of2palpatinesspiriturns.jpg|thumb|250px|A spirit urn in Palpatine's office]]
A '''spirit urn''' was an ornamental vase on a pedestal used by the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] to store important items such as the remains of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]. At the entrance of his [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends#Private Office (Private Use)|private office]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;who was secretly a Sith Lord&mdash;kept two [[Color/Legends|black]] spirit urns, one of which contained the ashes of his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].
